answers.assumption_check: Load-bearing: one NOTRUN marker can serve both systemd teeth and bwrap-only teeth (the orchestrator's scope, from Q#98), and a box that cannot run a proof is better off writing no seal than a third verdict. Not assumed: that no consumer reads teeth_printed's two-key dict by position; adding a key is additive, but every caller of teeth_printed is read at design time. The seal shape (no ninth field) is decided in D3, as CC's decision with the reversal named.
answers.builder_check: A Haiku builder cannot build this: the design (D1-D4) is the work, and the build splits into proof_coverage and tester tickets. The ticket carries the design and its decisions; each child ticket must restate its own bounds.
answers.children: two first-cut children by component: proof_coverage.teeth_printed learns NOTRUN (D1), and the tester's run_proof honours it (D2); to be cast when this leaves TICKETME
answers.collision_check: Looked at 9.4.2.3.3.1, 9.4.8.1 and Q#98, ticket 77f15efd5a96 (a green seal names at least one tooth, the rule D2 must not break for a green run) and test_shim_starts_the_loop.py's interim (d88887fbe31e). D2 changes how an all-NOTRUN run is judged, and the zero-teeth rule must stay for a run that prints nothing at all.
answers.falsifier_check: Clauses: (1) teeth_printed returns NOTRUN names in a third list and in neither green nor red | (2) an all-NOTRUN tester run writes no validation, is not RED and asks for the sealer; a mixed run seals the green teeth only. Horizon: red on current main (no marker is read; the zero-teeth rule reds an all-NOTRUN run), green after.
answers.gates_bound: proof gate (a hollow build must fail it) + durability gate (committed) + feeds-back-to-origin on failure (Laws 3 + 8).
answers.missing_check: Not wrapped: the verdict's own instrument run (9.4.8.1's bwrap-only tooth in the verdict, under bubblewrap) is a different run from a proof's run; this ticket uses the same marker for both but builds only the proof-run side. Also unmeasured: how many existing proofs would print NOTRUN (the Windows-red census). The build splits into one ticket per component (proof_coverage, tester) per RULE 1.
answers.questions: none, because the one choice that could be Akien's (a third verdict value or a ninth seal field versus no seal at all) is decided in D3 as CC's decision with its reversal named; it adds neither a verdict value nor a seal field, and the orchestrator ruled that such a choice goes to him as a [Q#n] only if it were a ninth field (press_office/CairnComponentOutline.txt 9.4.8.1, Q#98)
answers.title: a tooth that needs what a box lacks prints NOTRUN, which is neither green nor red, and the box records no seal for it

bullets.text: not-run is unbuilt: the tester reds an exit-0 proof with no green tooth, so a proof that cannot run on a box has no honest outcome. Cast at TICKETME as the class fix (systemd and bwrap teeth alike), decided as no seal on such a box.
